preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The maximum possible length of a journey on the string s is between 0 and the length of s inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(t1) > len(t2) and t2 in t1 for t1, t2 in zip(journey, journey[1:]))
postconditions.description: Each string in the journey is a proper substring of the previous string, and the journey is valid on s.

postconditions.expression: any(journey == [s[i:j] for i, j in zip([0] + [k for k in range(1, len(s)) if s[k] != s[k-1]], [k for k in range(1, len(s)) if s[k] != s[k-1]] + [len(s)])] for journey in valid_journeys) if return_value > 0 else True
postconditions.description: The journey can be constructed from the string s by selecting substrings that are proper substrings of each other.
